workshoptitle: Search Using MongoDB API for Oracle AI Database

tutorials.title: Introduction
tutorials.description: Review the search approaches, prerequisites, and workshop outcomes.

tutorials.title: Get Started: Access the LiveLabs Sandbox
tutorials.description: Sign in to OCI, open the provisioned database, install mongosh in Cloud Shell, and verify the MongoDB API connection.

tutorials.description: Load movies, query them through SQL and mongosh, and verify the ONNX model.

tutorials.description: Generate summary embeddings, create search indexes, and run keyword search.

tutorials.title: Lab 3: Run Semantic and Combined Searches
tutorials.description: Search summary embeddings, refine results, and combine text and vector branches.
